_readme: Provenance for every file the 7-agent REDUCED variant forks from the shared
tree.  Read by extra_utilities/smoke_test_fork_drift.py, which FAILS when an
origin file has been committed to since its fork was taken — that is the
whole point: drift here is otherwise invisible, because a stale fork produces
a plausible prompt rather than an error.
WHY A SIDECAR AND NOT A HEADER COMMENT.  Most forks are .md prompt files, and
a prompt has no comment syntax — every byte in it becomes system-prompt text
the model reads.  A provenance header would be tokens spent telling the model
about the repository.  Keeping it here costs the model nothing.
WHEN THE TEST FAILS, do not just bump the SHA.  Read what changed in the
origin (the test prints the exact git command), decide whether the fork needs
the same change, apply it if so, and only then record the new commit.  Bumping
without looking converts a loud check into a silent one.
relation:
copy         the fork began as a byte copy of the origin and was then edited;
any origin change is a candidate for porting.
rewrite      the fork REPLACES the origin's content for one agent and shares
no text with it; an origin change may still alter what the
rewrite needs to say, so it is still tracked.
partial-fork only part of the origin is re-implemented; the rest is imported
live, so only changes to the forked part matter.
new          a variant file with NO shared original — nothing to drift from.
Recorded anyway so the 'fork on disk with no entry' check stays
meaningful, and so a reader can tell a deliberate addition from
an unfiled fork.  origin and origin_commit are null.

forks.note: TC-32 compression; the CANNOT catalogue moved out to capabilities_cannot; metrics bullet gated behind <<MESH_ON>>. Reaches all 8 chain/hub agents.

RCP-20 compression, plus the catalogue received from hard_constraints_dc. Two live defects fixed here: 'cross-sections' -> 'arbitrary section cuts through the mesh' (CON-30), and the false downloads/uploads/cloud-storage bullet deleted. Reaches Receptionist + Orchestrator.

Per-agent scoped copy (prompts.SCOPED_FRAGMENTS). Shares no text with the origin: it states the one rule the UII can act on (the vocabulary constrains LABELLING, not RECORDING), resolving the standing conflict with 'Capture, do not filter'. Tracked because a change to the shared DC hard rules may still change what the UII needs told.

Batch 1: 11 reviewed compressions, 25,677 -> 18,877 chars. Includes the F58 fix (third categorisation bucket) and an unconditional 'view_images on EVERY image'. The standard prompt is actively worked on, so this is the highest-drift-risk fork in the set.

Prepended to a forwarded end-of-session feedback message by agents/orchestrator/feedback_tool.py::feedback_envelope(). No shared original EXISTS BY DESIGN: an absent override is the signal for 'no envelope', so every topology except 7-agent reduced gets "" and is behaviourally unchanged. Pairs with UII-20, which deletes the '## End-of-session feedback message (read-only)' section from the reduced prompts — the instruction travels with the message instead of sitting in eight prompts for a message that only exists at session save.

Only routing_instructions() is re-implemented (F59: the CLARIFY bullet names its own target instead of leaving each first-agent fragment to patch it). natural_pipeline, _authorisation_sources and _load_routing_fragment are IMPORTED live and must never be copied — _authorisation_sources drops the Planner when topology != 7 (F61).
